name: IndexDvd.trans
summary: Compose the two matrices: if m moves Φ into N and m' moves the result into P, then m'·m moves Φ into P and det(m'm) = det m'·det m divides z·a.

steps.claim: Let n and Φ_1, …, Φ_n ∈ M. By h there is an n×n matrix m with det m ∣ z (b.1) and Ψ_i = Σ_k m_{ik}Φ_k ∈ N for all i (b.2).
By g applied to Ψ there is m' with det m' ∣ a and Σ_i m'_{ji}Ψ_i ∈ P for all j. The matrix m'·m works: det(m'm) = det m'·det m divides a·z = z·a, and Σ_k (m'm)_{jk}Φ_k = Σ_i m'_{ji}Ψ_i ∈ P.
steps.lean: (g _ _ b.2).imp' (· * m) (by simp_all [mul_comm, mul_dvd_mul, mul_smul, ← Module.smul_apply]))
